events.summary: Maren said to Nemi: “Nemi, thank you for asking. I will keep it simple: first, look at the wound's edges and surrounding skin. Redness, warmth, swelling, or a spreading line of red can signal infection. A wound that smells foul, weeps thick or greenish fluid, or feels increasingly hot and painful is a warning. Clean with clean water, cover with a clean cloth, and watch for those signs over the next day. If the redness spreads or a fever follows, the wound needs more than a traveler can safely manage. I am glad to answer more if you wish.”

events.summary: Maren said to Nemi: “Nemi, thank you for asking. I will keep it simple: first, look at the wound's edges and surrounding skin. Redness, warmth, swelling, or a spreading line of red can signal infection. A wound that smells foul, weeps thick or greenish fluid, or feels increasingly hot and painful is a warning. Clean with clean water, cover with a clean cloth, and watch for those signs over the next day. If the redness spreads or a fever follows, the wound needs more than a traveler can safely manage. I am glad to answer more if you wish.”
